start_url.description: Required initial HTTP(S) URL. Query values must be declared separately as public literals or secret references.

environment.description: Optional deterministic browser settings. Defaults to 1280x720, en-US, UTC, light mode, reduced motion, and blocked service workers.

actions.description: Required sequence of explicit browser actions.

storage.description: Optional initial cookies, local storage, or session storage. Defaults to empty; every supplied value and origin must be declared and within the allowed origins.

secrets.description: Optional environment-variable references for values used in actions, URLs, storage, or replay, and for redacting matching observed text. Secret values are never supplied inline.

capture.description: Optional retained artifacts and event families. Defaults to only a final sanitized URL; request screenshots, DOM, accessibility, history, storage, and event capture explicitly.
